points: No cost to the charity — the donor pays the pickup fee

We follow your acceptance rules so you only receive what you can use

items.q: How much does a donation pickup cost?
items.a: It depends on the number and size of items and your location. Send us a list or photos and you'll get a fixed price before we come — no surprises.

items.q: Will I get a tax receipt?
items.a: The donation receipt comes from the charity that receives your items, not from Black Iron. Let us know you want one and we'll request it at drop-off when the charity offers it.

items.q: What if the charity refuses an item?
items.a: We check your items against the charity's rules before pickup. If something can't be donated, we'll offer to recycle or dispose of it and tell you the price in advance.

items.q: Can you mix donation and junk removal in one trip?
items.a: Yes — that's the most common job. We donate what can be donated, recycle what can be recycled and dispose of the rest, all in one visit.

story.title: Removing clutter, restoring peace
paragraphs: Black Iron Cleanouts, LLC was built on a simple idea: clearing out the clutter shouldn't be stressful. We bring the muscle, the truck and the care — so you can breathe again.

From single-item pickups to full estate cleanouts, we serve homeowners, renters and businesses across the greater Seattle and Everett area. We show up on time, quote honestly, and treat every property like it's our own.
We're proud to be a multicultural team that serves our neighbors in English, Spanish and Arabic.
